title: Multiple flues.
officialText:
When two or more flues are located in the same chimney, masonry wythes shall be built between adjacent
flue linings. The masonry wythes shall be at least 4 inches (102 mm) thick and bonded into the walls of the chimney.
Exception: When venting only one appliance, two flues are permitted to adjoin each other in the same chimney with only the
flue lining separation between them. The joints of the adjacent flue linings shall be staggered at least 4 inches (102 mm).
